name: Voyage Menu
description: Fullscreen menu overlay revealed by a clip-path wipe while the page behind tilts and scales away, with large staggered link letters and background images that crossfade on link hover.
contents: Logo text and square toggle button with two animated lines
Fullscreen overlay with large menu links and social links
Background image layers behind the overlay
Sample hero with heading, description and call to action button
behavior: Toggle opens the overlay with a diagonal clip-path reveal
Page content rotates, scales and shifts while the menu is open
Toggle lines morph into a cross
Menu link letters drop in with a stagger
Hovering a link crossfades and zooms a background image, leaving restores the first image
Clicking a link closes the menu
